# Getting help

DualMind Labs is a small team, and every message is read by a person. Pick the channel that fits.

| You need help with... | Go here |
|---|---|
| Using the Arena: battles, voting, the leaderboard | Start with the [docs](https://docs.dualmindlab.tech), especially the [Quickstart](https://docs.dualmindlab.tech/quickstart) |
| Your Arena account, signing in, or something that looks broken in the Arena | Email [support@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:support@dualmindlab.tech) and include the email you signed up with |
| A mistake, broken link or missing page in these docs | Open a [docs issue](https://github.com/dualmindlabs/arena-docs/issues/new/choose) |
| An idea for a new page or guide | Open a [docs request](https://github.com/dualmindlabs/arena-docs/issues/new/choose) |
| Partnerships, research or anything else | Email [hello@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:hello@dualmindlab.tech) or use the [contact page](https://dualmindlab.tech/contact) |
| Your data or privacy | Email [privacy@dualmindlab.tech](mailto:privacy@dualmindlab.tech) |
| A security problem | Do **not** open an issue. Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) |

## Is the API up?

The API reports its own health at
[api.dualmindlab.tech/health](https://api.dualmindlab.tech/health).

## Before you open an issue

- Search [existing issues](https://github.com/dualmindlabs/arena-docs/issues) first.
- Link the exact page (for example `https://docs.dualmindlab.tech/quickstart`).
- Never paste tokens, passwords or other secrets into an issue.
